primary_bin_score_vs_mixture.criterion: Disagreement bin log loss is lower in each seed and the paired three-seed same-source 95% interval is wholly below zero.

error_band_brier_vs_scale_and_mixture.criterion: Disagreement hit Brier is lower in each seed and the paired three-seed interval is wholly below zero versus both Scale and Mixture.

view_control_consistency.criterion: Disagreement beats Views on bin log loss and hit Brier in each seed, with both pooled paired intervals wholly below zero.

mdn_competitiveness.criterion: For each requested score, no per-seed or pooled 95% interval establishes a disadvantage versus MDN; no formal noninferiority margin is registered.

direct_hit_competitiveness.criterion: For hit Brier and hit log loss, no per-seed or pooled 95% interval establishes a disadvantage versus Direct-hit; no formal noninferiority margin is registered.

point_invariance.criterion: Every case's saved/recomputed native point prediction and MAE match the fixed anchor within 1e-6; MDN distribution median is allowed to differ.

registered_plan_gates.promotion_blocker: Official VALID results are development evidence, not source-transfer evidence; the registered nested outer-source rebuild and MOSEI replication remain outstanding.
registered_plan_gates.decision_scope: No TEST fitting, tuning, scoring, or claim of nested source transfer.
